svg.title: state diagram
svg.desc: A state diagram with 15 nodes and 16 edges. Organized in 1 group. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: __state_start, Idle, Processing. Key relationships: __state_start points to Idle; __state_start__state_Processing points to Validating; Validating points to Computing. Layout spans 526 by 1155 units with 15 rendered node boxes and 16 routed edge paths.

Processing points to Idle with label: complete
